summary: Iteration 6 testing complete: Multi-source AI discovery, CSV export, and public sharing features. Fixed critical route ordering bug for CSV export. All 18 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast shows 'Failed to create share link' even though API returns 200. This is due to clipboard API failing in browser (security restriction). The share functionality works correctly - only clipboard copy fails.
ui_bugs.note: This is expected behavior - clipboard requires user gesture and secure context. The share_id is created successfully.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CSV export route was defined after /ideas/{idea_id} causing 404. Moved to before dynamic route.
POST /api/scrape/discover correctly returns 402 for free users, 200 with ideas for pro users
GET /api/ideas/export-csv correctly returns 402 for free users, CSV file for pro users
GET /api/shared/{share_id} returns idea data without auth (public)
Dashboard shows Discover New, Scrape X, and CSV buttons with PRO badges for free users
SharedIdea page renders correctly with opportunity metrics and CTA
All existing features (auth, theme toggle, pricing, analytics, scan topic) still working
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 verified: 1) Multi-source discovery (POST /api/scrape/discover) works with AI-powered discovery from Reddit/ProductHunt/AppStore, 2) CSV export works for pro users, 3) Public sharing creates share links and SharedIdea page renders correctly, 4) Fixed route ordering bug for CSV export endpoint, 5) All 18 backend tests pass, 6) Frontend buttons show PRO badges for free users and are functional for pro users.

multi_source_discover.details: POST /api/scrape/discover returns 401 without auth, 402 for free users, 200 with ideas for pro users. Returns ideas from random source (reddit/producthunt/appstore) with live:true flag.

csv_export.details: GET /api/ideas/export-csv returns 401 without auth, 402 for free users, CSV file for pro users. Fixed route ordering bug - moved before /ideas/{idea_id}.

public_sharing.details: POST /api/ideas/{id}/share creates share_id (10 chars). GET /api/shared/{share_id} returns idea data without auth. GET /api/shared/invalid returns 404.

shared_idea_page.details: Frontend /shared/:shareId renders SharedIdea component with opportunity metrics, idea details, and CTA to sign up.

dashboard_buttons.details: Dashboard shows discover-all-btn, scrape-x-btn, export-csv-btn. Buttons show PRO badge and are disabled for free users.

idea_detail_share.details: IdeaDetail shows share-idea-btn. API call succeeds (200) but clipboard copy fails in automated testing (expected browser security restriction).

existing_features.details: Auth, theme toggle, pricing, analytics, scan topic, X scraping all still working.

mocked_apis_list: Multi-source discovery uses AI (GPT-4o) to simulate scraping from Reddit/ProductHunt/AppStore
X/Twitter scraping uses AI fallback when X API credentials fail
Password reset code returned in API response (demo mode)

bug_fixed.root_cause: Route /api/ideas/export-csv was defined after /api/ideas/{idea_id}, causing FastAPI to match 'export-csv' as an idea_id
bug_fixed.fix: Moved CSV export route definition before the dynamic /ideas/{idea_id} route in server.py
